name: Riften Ratway
summary: The Riften Ratway is a sewer beneath Riften that has become a den for thieves and criminals. Recently, vampires associated with the Icereach Coven have occupied the sewers and are in the process of massacring the remaining residents, with only a few still alive. It contains an entrance to the Riften Outlaws Refuge. During the related quest, Goharth Ironbelly and Sister Balra will meet here.
notes: The Ratway previously appeared in Skyrim.
